narration: An AI coding agent does a lot more than autocomplete.
onScreenText: AUTOCOMPLETE PREDICTS A LINE. AN AGENT PURSUES A GOAL.
captionText: An agent does more than autocomplete.
voiceDirection: Crisp opening. Contrast autocomplete with agent without sounding dramatic.

narration: With autocomplete, the tool predicts what comes next in the file you’re already editing. An agent starts with a goal.
captionText: Autocomplete predicts. An agent starts with a goal.
voiceDirection: Measured and explanatory. Small emphasis on goal.

narration: It can inspect the repository, find the files that matter, understand the current structure, and build context before it changes anything.
captionText: Inspect the repository before changing it.
voiceDirection: Use a clear rhythm through inspect, find, understand.

narration: Then it can build a plan: which files need to change, what order the work should happen in, and what result it needs to verify.
voiceDirection: Practical and deliberate. Let the plan feel intentional, not robotic.

narration: Then it edits the code. Because it has repository context, that can mean coordinated changes across multiple files instead of one isolated suggestion.
captionText: One goal can become coordinated multi-file changes.
voiceDirection: Confident, straightforward. Stress coordinated multi-file changes.

narration: But the important part is what happens next. It can run commands, execute tests, read the output, notice when something failed, and use that new information to keep going.
captionText: Failure becomes new context for the next step.
voiceDirection: Rhythmic but calm. Run, test, read, evaluate, repeat.

narration: That does not mean the agent should make every decision. You still review the diff, check whether the behavior matches what you asked for, and keep approval around sensitive changes.
captionText: The agent executes. You still verify.
voiceDirection: Grounded and firm. Human review is the point, not a warning.

narration: So the shift is simple: less “predict my next line,” more “take this goal, work through the steps, and bring me something I can verify.” Next, I’ll show you why a demo can work while the app is still fragile underneath.
onScreenText: GOAL → INSPECT → PLAN → CHANGE → TEST → EVALUATE → REVIEW
voiceDirection: Decisive summary, then lighter forward motion into V03.
